title: Taiwan VT Sensitivity Analysis: k/VIX Parameter Stability
method: k/VIX weight with clip [0.2, 1.5], shift(1) lag, TX cost 0.585%
conclusion: PASS: Taiwan VT strategy with k=8.63 passes listing criterion #4. Within +-20% range (6.90-10.36), max Sharpe drop is 2.2% (full) / 0.5% (OOS), both < 30%. Optimal k (full)=6, optimal k (OOS)=6. Fine grid optimal: full=6.0, OOS=6.5. The parameter is robust across a wide range.
